title: Analista de Projetos Sênior
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área: O escritório de projetos atua na padronização de processos de governanç arelacionados ag estão de projetos, facilitando o compartilhamento de reports, metodologias, ferramentas e técnicas para alcançar o desafio deimplementar iniciativas com sucesso. O Analista de Projetos elabora planos de execução e acompanha deperto os projetos do Grupo Fleury, atuando também no controle e nos estudos, garantindo que todas asinformações obtidas desse projeto sejam registradas e estejam em um local de fácil consulta


Principais atividades:


  • Realizar detalhamento do escopo do projeto, levantamento dos requisitos técnicos/funcionais relacionados aos projetos, mapear stakeholders e analisar, criticamente, a relevância e impacto em valor gerado, a fim de atender as necessidades do negócio;
  • Elaborar documentação, relatórios, atas, listas de pendências e outros registros a fim de garantir
  • rastreabilidade dos projetos, conforme metodologia estabelecida pelo Escritório de Projetos (PMO);
  • Analisar e acompanhar de forma diligente o escopo do projeto através de ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos e gerenciamento das eventuais mudanças, a fim de garantir a efetividade das ações definidas;
  • Garantir integração, comunicação e colaboração entre os membros do projeto e os stakeholdersatravés da elaboração Status Report e/ou ações de Gestão da Mudança, a fim de garantir alinhamento, atendimento aos requisitos, entregas acordadas e prazos estabelecidos;
  • Gerenciar testes, pilotos e acompanhar a implantação em produção dos projetos, a fim de garantir a preservação da operação existente;
  • Definir e acompanhar critérios de aceitação nas entregas, a fim de garantir a qualidade e atendimento de expectativas acordadas;
  • Acompanhar o orçamento do projeto, através da análise/custeio dos recursos necessários e dos custos ao longo do projeto, identificando e corrigindo os possíveis desvios;
  • Identificar, acompanhar e atualizar os riscos do projeto através de controle do projeto, dos planos de respostas aos riscos e do plano de gerenciamento, a fim de mitigar e reduzir os impactos;
  • Acompanhar a execução dos projetos pelos fornecedores visando garantir a aderência ao contrato Firmado.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Pacote Office – intermediário
  • MS Project – básico
  • Métodos ágeis – básico
  • Experiência prévia na condução de projetos de diferentes portes e complexidades
  • Superior Completo (Administração, Engenharia, TI ou áreas correlatas)?MBA em Gestão de Projetos (desejável)


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito


Informações da vaga:

  • Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)
  • Carga Horária: 44h Semanais
  • Escala: Segunda a sexta - feira
  • Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Operations Analytics
description:
We're looking for a Operations Analytics 100% remote in Brazil


Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Operations Analytics professional to deliver high-impact insights that support our end-to-end operations. In this role, you will work closely with teams across inventory, logistics, retail, and customer service, while partnering with technology and finance stakeholders. You’ll engage with nearly all aspects of a growing business to measure performance, identify opportunities, and drive alignment toward the most impactful operational improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze, understand, and quantify key operational efficiency metrics.
  • Design, implement, and report on item-level data throughout receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows.
  • Provide daily reporting and product-health measurements to support business decision-making.
  • Communicate insights clearly and effectively to partner teams and leadership.
  • Collaborate with operations analysts to optimize processes and uncover opportunities for growth.


Minimum Requirements:

  • 5+ years of analytics experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL.
  • 5+ years working with BI tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Looker, etc.
  • Strong ability to translate practical business problems into technical solutions.
  • Proven experience delivering time-sensitive strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, recommendations, and executive presentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in eCommerce or logistics industries.

description:
Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About The Role


Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. The FP&A team oversees the company's financial well-being while supporting operational and business planning in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. We work hard to ensure growth is accurately projected and that our financial results are properly accounted for.

We’re looking for an Senior FP&A Analyst who can help assess the opportunities ahead of us and support all areas of FP&A. This position will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, such as data analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling. If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models, please consider joining our team!


Key Responsibilities


  • Own updating and forecasting of Teachable Monthly P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow statements.
  • Put together monthly reporting powerpoint presentations.
  • Own all aspects of SG&A expense, tracking, and reporting internationally for Teachable.
  • Provide full visibility and tracking of company unit economics, and help the business drive operational efficiencies. This includes working closely with cross-functional partners to set targets and monitor performance such as LTV/CAC.
  • Support the finance department with ongoing analysis and forecasting for individual products and the overall company.
  • As needed, work on a variety of ad hoc and special projects that may include product or feature launches, pricing changes, or assessing the viability of new opportunities.


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree, preferred concentration in finance, accounting, management or related fields .
  • 4+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, or investment banking.
  • Advanced Excel Skills such as Power Query
  • Proficient financial, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • BI tooling (Sigma, PowerBI) and SAP experience a plus.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple projects and a willingness to learn.
  • Eagerness to learn and make a meaningful contribution.
  • Excitement to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Fluent english is required.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: Temporary


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Machine Learning Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil - Remote

Industry: IT & Services.


This position requires advanced communication skills in English, both written and verbal.


Machine Learning Engineer | About You

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you are responsible for turning complex data and business challenges into scalable, high‑impact AI solutions. You thrive in environments where experimentation meets engineering rigor, and you take pride in building systems that work reliably in the real world. You are the kind of person who enjoys staying ahead of industry trends—especially in LLMs and generative AI—and bringing that knowledge into practical, production-ready workflows. You’re excited by the opportunity to shape modern ML pipelines end‑to‑end, collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams, and continuously refine how AI drives value across an organization.


Machine Learning Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Develop and maintain scalable, reproducible machine learning pipelines across preprocessing, training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Build and optimize LLM-based solutions, including RAG approaches, embeddings, and semantic search capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to translate business needs into strong ML/AI system designs.
  • Prototype and deploy ML and deep learning models for transformation, ranking, prediction, and other applied use cases.
  • Design native workflows on AWS using Lambda, Step Functions, SageMaker, Bedrock, AgentCore, and related services.
  • Implement observability and monitoring tools to ensure reliability, stability, and compliance of models in production.


Machine Learning Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Machine Learning, with a proven track record deploying end‑to‑end ML/AI systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS AI/ML services including SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, and Step Functions, along with MLOps best practices.
  • Strong knowledge of LLMs, RAG architectures, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Proficiency in Python and ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch and scikit‑learn, familiarity with transformer-based models.
  • Solid understanding of model deployment, containerization, and monitoring.
  • Experience with data engineering for ML workflows (feature pipelines, schema versioning, data quality controls).
  • Advanced English proficiency for communication with a global, distributed team.

title: Azure Windows Solutions Architect
description:
Lead Azure & Windows Infrastructure Architect (POD 1 & 2)

Location: Remote / Hybrid | Experience: 13+ Years | Level: C5/C6 (Senior Leadership)

The Challenge

Are you a master of Windows ecosystems ready to lead the charge into the Cloud? We are looking for a Lead Infrastructure Architect to spearhead large-scale migrations for high-stakes industries like Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance.

In this role, you aren’t just a designer—you are the General of our Cloud PODs. You will lead a technical team of 5+ engineers, ensuring that complex legacy environments are modernized, secured, and migrated to Azure with surgical precision.

Your Impact

  • Architectural Sovereignty: Design the end-to-end \"Target State\" for massive enterprise environments. You will own the HLD (High-Level Design) and LLD (Low-Level Design) , ensuring every VM, Cluster, and Network packet has its place.
  • Lead the Squad: Act as the technical North Star for a team of 5+ infra experts. You will guide, govern, and mentor your team to deliver excellence under pressure.
  • Windows Modernization: You are the expert who knows Windows Clustering, DFS, and File/Print Services inside out. You’ll be the one to solve the \"impossible\" legacy issues during migration.
  • The Business Brain: You don't just build; you justify. You’ll use TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI metrics to prove to stakeholders that your architecture is the most efficient and cost-effective solution.
  • Mission Critical Support: You will oversee the stability of the environment, ensuring 24/7 reliability through robust Backup, DR, and Monitoring solutions.

What You Bring to the Table

  • The Veteran Background: 13+ years in IT with a deep focus on Windows Server and Azure IaaS/PaaS .
  • Migration Mastery: Expert-level experience with Azure Migrate for server consolidation and workload shifts.
  • Networking & Identity Guru: Deep knowledge of DNS, DHCP, WINS, and Azure IAM/Key Vault to keep our Landing Zones secure and connected.
  • Resilience Expert: Hands-on experience with Windows Clustering and Azure Site Recovery (ASR) for business continuity.
  • Strategic Communicator: You can navigate a 24x7 shift environment, manage customer calls with poise, and present complex solutions to C-suite stakeholders.

The Toolkit

  • Core: Azure Infrastructure, Windows Server (all versions), Azure Networking.
  • Leadership: Team Management & Technical Governance.
  • Compliance: Experience in regulated domains (SIAM, Data Privacy, Financial regulations).
  • Certifications (Preferred): AZ-305 (Solutions Architect Expert) or AZ-104 .

Why This Role?

This is more than a migration job; it’s a leadership opportunity. You will own the strategy for POD 1 and 2 , deciding how global enterprises evolve. If you enjoy solving complex \"under-the-hood\" Windows issues while simultaneously designing high-level cloud strategies, this is your next career move.

Ready to lead the migration? Apply now and let’s build the future of Enterprise Cloud.

What makes this version effective?

  • Directly addresses the \"POD\" structure: It makes the candidate feel like they are leading a specific mission.
  • Highlights the Hybrid nature: It acknowledges that they need to be good at both the new (Azure) and the old (Windows Clustering/DFS).
  • Emphasizes Leadership: By using words like \"General\" and \"North Star,\" you attract people who want to manage teams, not just configurations.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Azure SQL Solutions Architect (Level P5/P6/P7)

Location: Remote / Hybrid | Experience: 15+ Years | Sector: Enterprise Cloud Transformation

The Mission

Are you a visionary architect who lives at the intersection of Data and Infrastructure ? We are looking for a heavy-hitter to lead massive, high-stakes cloud migrations for some of the world’s largest brands in Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance.

As our SQL Architect , you aren't just moving databases; you are reimagining how global enterprises operate in the cloud. You will be the technical authority responsible for auditing complex legacy environments and architecting the future-state of Azure Data & Infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect the Future: Conduct deep-dive \"AS-IS\" assessments and design sophisticated \"Target State\" architectures that get approved by executive review boards.
  • Lead the Migration: Drive large-scale Azure migration activities, utilizing Azure Migrate to move complex on-prem workloads to the cloud.
  • Master the Landing Zone: Design and build secure, scalable Azure Landing Zones from the ground up, ensuring identity (IAM), security (Key Vault), and governance are baked-in.
  • Blueprint Excellence: Produce high-fidelity HLD (High-Level Design) and LLD (Low-Level Design) documents covering the entire Azure ecosystem.
  • Be the Expert: Provide technical leadership in troubleshooting deep-stack issues (Networking, IO, Clusters) and define the BoM (Bill of Materials) to ensure clients get maximum value for their investment.

What We’re Looking For

  • The Veteran: 15+ years of IT experience, with at least a decade dedicated to the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.
  • The SQL Specialist: Deep, hands-on mastery of Azure SQL (IaaS & PaaS) , Azure Storage, and high-availability data solutions.
  • The Strategist: Experience in Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery (BCDR) and infrastructure-as-code principles.
  • The Communicator: Ability to bridge the gap between deep technical troubleshooting and C-suite stakeholder management.
  • The Industry Expert: Previous success navigating the regulatory complexities of the Banking or Healthcare sectors.

Technical Toolkit

  • Primary: Azure SQL, Azure Migrate, IAM, Key Vault, Storage.
  • Architecture: Mastery of Frameworks (TOGAF or similar), HLD/LLD creation.
  • Certification (The Cherry on Top): AZ-305 (Infrastructure Solutions) or AZ-104 (Administrator).

Why Join Us?

You will work on projects of massive scale where your designs directly impact the security and efficiency of global financial and medical data. This is a role for an architect who wants to own the \"Big Picture\" while staying sharp on the technical details.

Ready to build the next generation of Cloud Infrastructure? Let’s talk.

title: Analytics Architect – Azure Databricks / Fabric
description:
Analytics Architect – Azure Databricks / Microsoft Fabric


Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric .
  • Partner closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to translate requirements into scalable analytics platforms.
  • Own the end-to-end delivery of data solutions, ensuring adherence to architectural standards, security, governance and best practices.
  • Design, build and optimize data ingestion pipelines and ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Databricks, PySpark and Azure Data Factory .
  • Integrate Databricks with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric and on-premise systems.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams, promoting continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of architecture, data flows and operational processes.
  • Enforce best practices around code quality, performance optimization, scalability and data security.
  • Stay current with Databricks and Azure analytics advancements to continuously evolve the platform.


Essential Skills

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebooks and Delta Lake .
  • Strong proficiency in PySpark , Spark and big data technologies (Hadoop ecosystem).
  • In-depth knowledge of Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory , Power BI, SSRS, SSAS and SKU transitions (PSKU to F SKU).
  • Expertise in building data lakes, data warehouses and large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Advanced SQL skills with familiarity in NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines , Git and modern DevOps practices.
  • Solid understanding of cloud security and governance principles.


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to risk mitigation.
  • Proven leadership and mentoring capabilities.


Nice to Have

  • Advanced experience with Power BI for reporting and analytics.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration workloads.
  • Experience with Spark Streaming for real-time data processing.
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and Infrastructure as Code practices.


Experience Requirements

  • 12+ years of experience building data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks, Synapse Notebooks and Azure Data Factory .
  • Hands-on expertise with Delta Tables, Delta Lake and ADLS Gen2 .
  • Experience using Auto Loader and Delta Live Tables for scalable data ingestion.
  • Proven ability to build and optimize query layers using Databricks SQL .
  • Demonstrated integration of Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2 and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions.
  • Prior experience designing, optimizing and deploying Power BI dashboards and reports .
  • Strong exposure to modern CI/CD frameworks within Databricks and cloud-native environments.

title: AI Video Ad Creator +  Copywriter + Visual Asset Designer
description:
The opportunity


We’re building a high-output creative engine for paid ads-and we’re looking for a specialist who can write the words that sell and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form video ads using AI video tools, strong editing, and performance thinking.


This is not a “make pretty videos” role. This is concept → copy → creative → iterations → winners .

If you live at the intersection of genAI + storytelling + conversion copywriting , this role is for you.


You’ll create AI-driven video ads and visual assets for campaigns across TikTok, Instagram Reels/Stories, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and more. We optimize for ROAS, CTR, CVR, hook rate, hold rate, and retention -and the copywriting is a core lever in every asset we ship.


What you’ll do


You own the creative from message to motion-including the copywriting .

Copywriting + creative strategy

  • Write conversion-focused short-form scripts (15-45s) : hooks, problem framing, proof, offer, CTA.
  • Create multiple copy angles per concept (pain-based, benefit-based, curiosity, contrarian, founder POV, social proof, demo-driven).
  • Write and version hook lines, VO scripts, on-screen text, captions, headlines, end-card CTAs , and thumbnail copy.
  • Translate product benefits into clear, punchy, platform-native messaging (no fluff, no generic AI-sounding copy).
  • Apply direct-response frameworks (Problem → Agitation → Solution, Before/After, Myth-busting, Objection handling, etc.) with modern pacing.

Video production + asset creation

  • Produce short-form ad creatives designed for conversion (tight cuts, retention-first pacing, pattern interrupts).
  • Create AI-generated video sequences and combine them with real footage/UGC where needed.
  • Generate visual assets for ad variations: thumbnails, product scenes, backgrounds, overlays, cutdowns, motion graphics, end cards.
  • Build multiple versions of the same concept (different hooks, copy angles, pacing, captions, VO, formats).
  • Work from a brief and deliver fast iterations based on performance feedback.
  • Maintain brand consistency while still pushing creative boundaries.
  • Collaborate with growth/marketing to align creative with testing strategy and learnings.


Minimum requirements (non-negotiable)


To be considered, you must meet the requirements below and include proof in your application:

  • Resume must be written in English.
  • You must share examples of your AI video ad work with VO and Dialogue (not just AI visuals).
  • Copywriting is required: you must provide evidence you wrote/owned the scripts and ad copy for at least some of the work you share (scripts, hook lists, on-screen text, captions, or a short case study describing your role).
  • You must provide at least ONE of the following:
  • Evidence you produced creatives that generated strong ROAS / conversion lift (screenshots, case study, or summary metrics), OR
  • A video you produced that achieved 10,000+ views , OR
  • Proof you can create complex AI short-form ad videos (not basic slideshow edits-think narrative, scene continuity, ad pacing, multiple AI shots, strong compositing).
  • You have managed or been part of a social media account with 10,000+ followers .


What “qualified” looks like (skills we’re actively looking for)


You don’t just edit-you communicate and convert.

  • You understand what makes a video ad perform: thumb-stopping hooks, clear messaging, pattern interrupts, pacing, proof, offer structure, CTA clarity .
  • You can write direct-response copy that sounds human, specific, and brand-right-not generic “AI marketing” language.
  • You can create AI-driven visuals that look intentional and brand-ready (not uncanny or generic).
  • You can edit like a performance creator: tight cuts, retention-first pacing, captions, kinetic typography, sound design.
  • You have a repeatable workflow to deliver high volume with high quality (and keep assets organized).


Tools & workflows (use what you’re best at)


We’re tool-agnostic, but you should be highly capable with several of the following:

AI + creative

  • AI video generation (e.g., Runway, Pika, or comparable tools)
  • AI image generation (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Voice & audio (AI voiceover tools, sound design, music selection, cleanup)

Editing + delivery

  • Editing & motion (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, etc.)
  • Creative versioning + organized file delivery (naming conventions, aspect ratios, exports)

Copywriting workflow (important)

  • You can work quickly in tools like Docs/Notion , and you know how to build:
  • Hook banks
  • Script variations
  • Angle matrices
  • Offer/CTA libraries
  • Caption + primary text variants aligned to the video


Deliverables & expectations


Typical output: 10 ad creatives per month (depending on campaign cycle), plus variations.

Format mastery: 9:16 primary , plus 1:1 and 16:9 cutdowns when needed.

You can deliver:

  • Final exports (platform-ready)
  • Project files when requested
  • Source assets used (AI outputs, overlays, audio references)

Copy deliverables (required):

  • Script + VO text (or structured script outline)
  • Hook variations (often 5-15 per concept)
  • On-screen text + caption plan (what appears when, and why)
  • End card copy + CTA variants
  • Optional: primary text/caption variants for Meta/TikTok where needed

Turnaround: fast iteration is key (often 24-72 hours per revision cycle , depending on scope).


How we evaluate success


  • Your creatives clearly map to an angle + message and drive action.
  • Iterations improve performance (hooks improve, retention improves, CTR/CVR improves).
  • Your output is consistent, organized, and easy to test at scale.
  • Your copy + editing work together (the words and visuals reinforce the same conversion story).

﻿

Compensation


Competitive and flexible based on experience and proof of performance.

Per project bases

If you’re a performance-minded AI creative who can write high-converting scripts and ship high-quality ads fast -and you have proof-apply with the items above.

title: Program Coordinator
description:
About Sofia Health

Sofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1:1 services, we’re making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses.


Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, iRest, health coaching, and more.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Virtual Wellness Program Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our Sofia Prime program. In this role, you’ll help with day-to-day operations, communicate with instructors, support clients, ensure a seamless experience for both sides of the platform, and help expand participation and engagement across the platform.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role ideal for someone passionate about wellness, tech-enabled solutions, and community building.


Responsibilities
  • Coordinate and publish weekly and monthly live class schedules
  • Communicate with wellness instructors to confirm availability, gather class details, and ensure timely updates
  • Provide basic support to clients and instructors (e.g., tech check-ins, live session support, FAQs)
  • Assist with monitoring class attendance and flagging any issues or trends
  • Help gather and organize feedback from members to improve class offerings
  • Collaborate with marketing and community teams to promote upcoming classes
  • Maintain accurate records and help ensure consistent program delivery


Requirements
  • 1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
  • Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Bonus Points
  • Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup
  • Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company
  • Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior (Python)
description:
A Ivy Group está com uma nova oportunidade para Engenheiro de Software Sênior (Python) atuar em um de nossos clientes do setor financeiro.

Buscamos um profissional com perfil executor, organizado e colaborativo, que tenha facilidade em entender regras de negócio e transformá-las em integrações e soluções técnicas.

O ambiente é dinâmico, com entregas semanais e desafios constantes. É importante ter boa comunicação, senso de responsabilidade e autonomia para lidar com mudanças de prioridade de forma madura e estruturada.

Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) ou Cooperativa.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Python.

  • Experiência em integração entre sistemas e manipulação de dados em formatos como JSON e CSV.
  • Conhecimento prático em bancos de dados relacionais e consultas SQL.

  • Comprometimento com horários e rituais do time, garantindo constância e confiabilidade nas entregas.

  • Experiência em processos de ingestão de dados ou integração com ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, DBT, ou similares).
  • Familiaridade com Snowflake ou outros bancos de dados em nuvem.
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes financeiros ou corporativos de alta criticidade.
  • Prática com testes unitários, boas práticas de código limpo e documentação técnica.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs, integrações e rotinas backend que conectam sistemas internos e externos.
  • Implementar soluções para receber, tratar e disponibilizar dados de forma estruturada e segura.
  • Colaborar com o time de engenharia de dados, garantindo coerência na entrada e saída das informações que passam pelas integrações.
  • Traduzir demandas de produto e negócio em entregas técnicas claras e eficientes.

  • Identificar gargalos e propor melhorias em processos e fluxos de integração.
  • Manter documentação atualizada de endpoints, parâmetros e dependências entre sistemas.
  • Atuar com autonomia e senso de dono, reportando avanços e eventuais bloqueios de forma proativa.


Perfil comportamental

  • Proatividade: busca soluções e esclarece dúvidas sem depender de microgestão.
  • Resiliência: mantém a qualidade sob pressão e diante de mudanças rápidas.
  • Autonomia: organiza o próprio trabalho e garante previsibilidade nas entregas.
  • Comunicação: expressa-se de forma clara, especialmente em interações remotas.
  • Colaboração: mantém boa relação com o time técnico e de produto, valorizando o fluxo coletivo de entrega.

title: Customer Support Specialist (English)
description:
Genesis is a full-service international IT company. More than 1,500 people in five countries create products for more than 200 million unique monthly users. We are one of the largest partners of Facebook, Google, Snapchat, and Apple in Eastern Europe. Our ecosystem consists of more than 15 companies and an investment fund.


EverHelp is a company in the Genesis ecosystem. We’re a team of professionals, that’s developing outsourcing support services for plenty of products all over the world at a dynamic tempo. The project launched in 2021, and we've experienced a yearly growth rate of +82%. Since February 2022, we've managed to preserve all our workplaces and, most importantly, we continue to strengthen our team while maintaining an employee satisfaction rate of over 90%.


Role Mission:

Support our new partner’s growth by strengthening client success and delivering ongoing, high-quality support.


Your future responsibilities include:

  • Handle customer inquiries via phone, email/back office, and chat,
  • Meet service quality targets:
  • Voice: Call abandon rate <2%, first contact resolution >80%, CSAT >4.5/5,
  • Email/Back Office: ≥95% accuracy, rework ≤5%,
  • Chat: ≥95% first response within 60s, ≥85% resolved within SLA, CSAT ≥4.5/5,
  • Work on a variety of cases with opportunities for continuous learning,
  • Collaborate closely with an international partner on diverse and engaging tasks,
  • Work within business hours across time zones from PST to EST.

Senior Revenue Operations Manager


We are looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to own and continuously improve our Salesforce instance and broader sales tech stack.


You will maintain and evolve Salesforce, connect and manage key sales tools, and translate revenue data into dashboards and analyses that directly inform sales leadership and frontline reps.


This is a hands-on role for someone with 5-10 years of experience who can operate independently, prioritize intelligently, and partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.


Key Responsibilities:

-Salesforce Administration & Ownership

  • Own day-to-day administration of Salesforce (users, roles, profiles, permissions, objects, fields, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards)
  • Maintain data quality through validation, deduplication, and ongoing hygiene processes
  • Implement and improve sales processes (lead management, opportunity stages, forecasting, pipeline management)
  • Manage releases, sandbox testing, and change management


-Sales Tech Stack & Integrations

  • Manage and maintain integrations between Salesforce and other GTM tools (e.g., HubSpot/Marketo, Outreach/Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo, CPQ, billing tools)
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and coordinate with vendors as needed
  • Evaluate new tools and support implementation and rollout


-Reporting, Dashboards & Insights

  • Build and maintain dashboards for sales leadership and reps (pipeline, forecast, activity, conversion rates, performance)
  • Produce recurring and ad hoc analyses to support forecasting, territory planning, quota setting, and performance reviews
  • Translate unstructured data into actionable business insights


-Cross-Functional Revenue Support

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to align systems and data
  • Support planning cycles (forecasting, QBRs, capacity models)
  • Act as a trusted operational partner to sales leadership


Required Qualifications:

  • 5-10 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Salesforce Administration
  • Hands-on experience administering Salesforce in a production environment
  • Strong understanding of sales processes, funnels, and pipeline management
  • Experience managing or supporting sales tech tools and integrations
  • Proficiency with Salesforce reporting and dashboards
  • Ability to translate business questions into data and systems solutions


Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Administrator certification
  • Experience with tools like HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach, Salesloft, Gong, or similar
  • Experience with basic SQL or BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)

Why This Role

  • High impact on revenue execution and sales effectiveness
  • Broad exposure to systems, data, and go-to-market strategy

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;

● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;

● Desenvolver e manter padrões arquiteturais específicos para a BU (design patterns, governança, observabilidade, práticas de versionamento, guidelines de APIs);

● Elaborar e gerenciar artefatos de decisão técnica (ADRs, RFCs, RFPs), documentando mudanças estruturais e justificativas;

● Apoiar squads na modelagem de domínios, integrações, definição de SLAs/SLIs/SLOs e desenho de fluxos críticos;

● Conduzir análises de capacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;

● Avaliar e introduzir tecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;

● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;

● Propor e desenvolver PoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;

● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;

● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);

● Trabalhar lado a lado com líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável)

● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos

● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência


Bancos de Dados e Persistência

● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos)

● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic)


Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade

● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready

● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal))

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (TypeScript)
description:
Radity is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. Were passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.


Were currently looking for a TypeScript Fullstack Engineer to join our remote-first development team. If you're someone who thrives in a fast-paced tech environment and enjoys working with modern tools like NestJS, Node.js, Next.js, and cloud services this is your chance to build great software with a passionate team.


Your Role

As a Fullstack Engineer at Radity, you'll work on complex and impactful applications using TypeScript across the stack. Were especially interested in candidates with strong backend skills in Node.js and NestJS.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain scalable full-stack web applications using TypeScript and Node.js and NestJS.
  • Build and maintain backend services using Fastify and modern API design principles.
  • Develop responsive and performant frontend applications using React, TanStack (Query/Table/Router), and Mantine.
  • Design, implement, and maintain data models and database interactions using Prisma ORM.
  • Integrate with internal and external REST APIs and third-party services.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers in a distributed, cross-functional team.
  • Ensure code quality through code reviews, testing, and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the full stack in both development and production environments.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) B2+ level or higher.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and backend development with Node.js and NestJS.
  • Hands-on experience with Fastify or similar Node.js frameworks (Express, NestJS, etc.)
  • Solid experience with React and modern frontend tooling, including TanStack libraries.
  • Experience with Prisma ORM and relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred).
  • Good understanding of RESTful APIs, backend architecture, and data modeling.
  • A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and appreciation for clean, maintainable code.


What's In It for You

  • A remote-first role where you can work from anywhere.
  • Hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies and real-world challenges.
  • Supportive teammates who value quality, learning, and growth.
  • Opportunities to shape architecture and technical direction.
  • Flexible hours and a collaborative, open culture.
  • Support for certifications, learning resources, or professional development.

title: Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator

Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator


LegalSight is an exciting legal services firm at the crossroads of global innovation. Our company provides intellectual property-related legal technology and services for clients around the world. Our team specializes in products, software, and services to assist with patent and trademark application processes, including filing, renewals, and translations.


The Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator will work within our international legal translations division. This is an administrative, non-technical position focused on document review and proofreading.


The Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator will conduct quality assessments on translated legal documents. Key responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborate with the Project Management team to clarify project parameters.

A successful Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator must have:

  • Experience in reviewing and proofreading translated documents, particularly legal documents.
  • Experience with CAT tools is highly preferred.
  • A high degree of proficiency in relevant computer skills (Microsoft Office).

  • Ability to manage time effectively.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Proven problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work well in both independent and highly collaborative settings.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply

title: Senior CISCO Engineer – Cisco Voice (CUCM, SIP)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Unified Communications Engineer with deep expertise in enterprise voice and telephony , who can lead and support the transition from Cisco on-premises UC environments to Microsoft Teams Phone and modern CCaaS platforms .


This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on design, migration, and Tier 3 support , working in a global enterprise environment across EMEA, US, and APAC.



Required


  • 7+ years of experience in Unified Communications / Enterprise Voice .

Strong hands-on experience with:

  • Microsoft Teams Phone
  • Cisco Voice (CUCM, SIP)
  • Solid understanding of telephony fundamentals and SIP-based architectures .
  • Experience supporting or implementing cloud-based telephony solutions .
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) – mandatory.


Nice to Have


  • Experience with Oracle SBC , Avaya, or similar platforms.
  • Exposure to Contact Center solutions (Cisco UCCE, Five9, NICE CXone).
  • Experience working in large enterprise or global environments .


What You’ll Do


Microsoft Teams Phone & Cloud Telephony

  • Design, implement, and support Microsoft Teams Phone solutions.
  • Lead and support Direct Routing, Operator Connect, and Calling Plans .
  • Integrate Teams Phone with SBCs and telecom providers .


Enterprise Voice & Cisco UC


  • Support and maintain Cisco on-premises voice infrastructure , including:
  • Cisco Call Manager (CUCM)
  • SIP Trunking
  • Provide Tier 3 / engineering-level support for complex voice issues.


Contact Center & CCaaS


  • Support migrations of Contact Center platforms:
  • From Cisco UCCE / Five9
  • To NICE CXone CCaaS
  • Ensure stable SIP connectivity between telephony and CCaaS platforms.


Migration & Global Rollouts


  • Execute telephony migration plans with minimal service disruption.
  • Support global go-live events and post-migration stabilization.
  • Collaborate with regional engineering teams and vendors worldwide.



¡Join Us!


  • Work on enterprise-scale UC and telephony transformations .
  • Gain deep exposure to Teams Phone and CCaaS modernization .
  • Collaborate with global teams and leading technology partners.
  • Play a key role in high-visibility, business-critical projects

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Analista BPO Contábil
description:
O Analista Contábil Pleno será responsável pela execução e suporte das rotinas contábeis em um ambiente de terceirização de processos (BPO), garantindo a precisão nas operações contábeis e aderência às normas e legislações vigentes. Atuará diretamente com diversos sistemas ERP, sendo responsável pela conciliação contábil, fechamentos mensais e apuração de resultados, além de prestar suporte em projetos de migração de sistemas e melhorias de processos. Fazendo parte do time você terá a oportunidade de:

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis (CRC ativo ou em andamento).
  • Conhecimento atualizado em normas contábeis (BRGAAP, IFRS).
  • Domínio em lançamentos contábeis, conciliações, fechamento de balanços e balancetes.
  • Experiência no uso de diferentes sistemas ERP para a execução de rotinas contábeis.
  • Conhecimento em obrigações acessórias relacionadas à contabilidade, como SPED Contábil e ECF.


Experiência Desejável:

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência na área contábil, preferencialmente em empresas de BPO ou consultorias.
  • Atuação com diversos sistemas de ERP (ex: TOTVS, SAP, Omie, Sankhya, Linx, Questor), garantindo adaptação a diferentes plataformas tecnológicas.
  • Vivência em processos de conciliação bancária, provisões, e controle de ativo imobilizado.
  • Experiência em projetos de migração de sistemas contábeis e integração de dados entre sistemas.


Obs: Conhecimento no sistema Linx, será um grande diferencial.

Autonomia:

  • Possuem maior autonomia para realizar suas tarefas e tomar decisões.
  • Podem supervisionar e orientar analistas Junior.


Principais atividades:

  • Conciliação contábil e bancária, assegurando que os lançamentos sejam devidamente registrados e conferidos em sistemas ERP diversos.
  • Fechamento contábil mensal e anual, garantindo a preparação e revisão de balanços, balancetes e demonstrações financeiras.
  • Análise de resultados e elaboração de relatórios contábeis, garantindo a correta apuração dos dados e aderência às normas contábeis.
  • Geração e entrega das obrigações acessórias contábeis, como SPED Contábil e ECF, em conformidade com os prazos e exigências legais.
  • Participação em projetos de migração e integração de sistemas ERP, realizando ajustes contábeis e adequando as rotinas de acordo com os novos sistemas implantados.
  • Suporte ao atendimento de auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo as informações contábeis necessárias para revisão e avaliação.
  • Gerenciar a equipe contábil, promovendo o desenvolvimento contínuo dos colaboradores, é responsável pela aplicação da Avaliação de Desempenho da equipe, elaboração de PDIs, controle de jornada de ponto, e reuniões de feedbacks com a equipe.

  • ·       Vale alimentação/Refeição: para contribuir com sua alimentação;

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Senior Revenue Operations Manager


We are looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to own and continuously improve our Salesforce instance and broader sales tech stack.


You will maintain and evolve Salesforce, connect and manage key sales tools, and translate revenue data into dashboards and analyses that directly inform sales leadership and frontline reps.


This is a hands-on role for someone with 5-10 years of experience who can operate independently, prioritize intelligently, and partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.


Key Responsibilities:

-Salesforce Administration & Ownership

  • Own day-to-day administration of Salesforce (users, roles, profiles, permissions, objects, fields, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards)
  • Maintain data quality through validation, deduplication, and ongoing hygiene processes
  • Implement and improve sales processes (lead management, opportunity stages, forecasting, pipeline management)
  • Manage releases, sandbox testing, and change management


-Sales Tech Stack & Integrations

  • Manage and maintain integrations between Salesforce and other GTM tools (e.g., HubSpot/Marketo, Outreach/Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo, CPQ, billing tools)
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and coordinate with vendors as needed
  • Evaluate new tools and support implementation and rollout


-Reporting, Dashboards & Insights

  • Build and maintain dashboards for sales leadership and reps (pipeline, forecast, activity, conversion rates, performance)
  • Produce recurring and ad hoc analyses to support forecasting, territory planning, quota setting, and performance reviews
  • Translate unstructured data into actionable business insights


-Cross-Functional Revenue Support

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to align systems and data
  • Support planning cycles (forecasting, QBRs, capacity models)
  • Act as a trusted operational partner to sales leadership


Required Qualifications:

  • 5-10 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Salesforce Administration
  • Hands-on experience administering Salesforce in a production environment
  • Strong understanding of sales processes, funnels, and pipeline management
  • Experience managing or supporting sales tech tools and integrations
  • Proficiency with Salesforce reporting and dashboards
  • Ability to translate business questions into data and systems solutions


Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Administrator certification
  • Experience with tools like HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach, Salesloft, Gong, or similar
  • Experience with basic SQL or BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Exposure to SaaS metrics (ARR, MRR, churn, CAC, LTV)
  • Experience supporting forecasting and territory/quota planning


Why This Role

  • High impact on revenue execution and sales effectiveness
  • Broad exposure to systems, data, and go-to-market strategy

description:

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply

title: Executive Assistant (100% remote)
description:
MANDATORY to complete your application:


About the Role:


Are you an assertive, precise, and autonomous professional with strong organizational skills and a passion for providing high-level administrative support? We are looking for an Executive Assistant to assist with administrative tasks and provide general support to our executive team. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is highly organized, and can handle multiple tasks independently.


As an Executive Assistant, you will be responsible for supporting the day-to-day operations, managing communications, and anticipating the needs of our leadership team. Your ability to manage complex schedules, handle sensitive information, and communicate effectively in both Spanish and English will ensure smooth and efficient operations.


As an Executive Assistant, you will:

  • Assist with calendar management and schedule meetings for the executive team.
  • Respond to and manage emails promptly and professionally.
  • Handle messages and calls, ensuring clear communication.
  • Book travel arrangements including flights and hotel reservations, ensuring all logistics are in order.
  • Provide support with daily tasks such as making calls, organizing appointments, and conducting online research.
  • Anticipate needs and proactively propose solutions to improve efficiency.


Required Qualifications

  • Fluent in English and Spanish.
  • Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or in administrative support roles.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to handle competing priorities.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills, anticipating needs and offering solutions.
  • Ability to work independently while providing high-level support.
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment and managing confidential information.


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant supervision or struggle with independent decision-making.
  • You prefer a non-structured work environment without clear goals and processes.


APPLY NOW:


This is an external position to work at a WiseVAs client. Considering that the management of job positions is entirely handled by the hiring companies, and that WiseVAs operates solely as an intermediary between the candidate and the hiring company, the submission of proposals by candidates does not guarantee employment. Similarly, candidates acknowledge and authorize the storage of resumes and proposals in WiseVAs's database, as well as the receipt of messages, emails, and calls offering new job positions and opportunities.
