title: Head de Projetos
description:
VAGA: Head de Operações

Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Head de Operações para liderar a construção e evolução do nosso modelo de gestão. Esta pessoa será responsável por estruturar processos, implementar métricas de performance, padronizar rotinas e garantir que os rituais de acompanhamento sejam adotados em todas as áreas operacionais, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento sustentável da empresa.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Desenhar e estruturar os processos operacionais da empresa, definindo fluxos, indicadores e rotinas.
  • Implementar e conduzir o modelo de gestão , promovendo sua aplicação em todas as áreas envolvidas.
  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe operacional, garantindo alto desempenho e alinhamento cultural.
  • Utilizar metodologias de gestão de projetos , como PDCA, 5W2H, Kaizen, entre outras, para melhoria contínua.
  • Conduzir análises estratégicas e propor soluções que aumentem produtividade e eficiência.
  • Participar da definição e desdobramento de metas juntamente com a Diretoria.
  • Realizar acompanhamento constante de indicadores, resultados e evolução de processos.
  • Ser referência técnica em qualidade, planejamento e execução .


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Formação em Engenharia de Produção , Engenharia de Processos ou Engenharia de Projetos .
  • Experiência de 4 a 5 anos em gestão de equipes e liderança direta.
  • Vivência comprovada em gestão de projetos e melhoria de processos .
  • Experiência prática no uso de ferramentas da qualidade e planejamento estratégico .
  • Domínio de PDCA e métodos de análise e otimização de processos .


Soft Skills Necessárias

  • Objetividade na comunicação e tomada de decisão.
  • Forte capacidade de planejamento e organização .
  • Calma e equilíbrio emocional para lidar com situações de pressão.
  • Visão analítica para leitura de dados e indicadores.
  • Visão sistêmica para correlacionar impactos e propor soluções sustentáveis.
  • Liderança orientada ao desenvolvimento e clareza na gestão de expectativas.


Perfil Ideal

Buscamos alguém prático(a), estruturado(a) e estratégico(a) , que consiga equilibrar a visão de longo prazo com a execução diária. Uma pessoa que não apenas desenhe processos, mas que tenha habilidade de garantir sua aplicação junto ao time, consolidando uma cultura de gestão sólida .


Desafio da Função

Construir do zero um modelo de gestão claro, eficiente e replicável — e garantir sua adoção na rotina de trabalho .

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Client's growing team.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in web development with expertise in React , JavaScript, and Python . They must be comfortable working independently and will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining a high-performance web application.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain a robust, scalable web application, handling both front-end (JavaScript, React) and back-end (Python) responsibilities.
  • Take leadership of architecture and design efforts for new features within the application, ensuring alignment with best practices and company standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineers, to help design, iterate, & develop new features.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to coding standards and best practices.
  • Maintain and optimize existing codebase to maximize stability, performance and scalability.
  • Work with Python to develop backend services and APIs, and with JavaScript and React to enhance front-end processes and functionality.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers, providing technical leadership and helping them grow their skills.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and consistency across the team.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes, tools, and methodologies.
  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends, tools, and technologies, and recommend improvements to the technology stack.
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues across the full stack of the application.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience , with a strong focus on web development with Python .
  • Proficiency in React , JavaScript (ES5+), and modern web development practices.
  • Experience with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically about issues.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Proven experience leading projects and mentoring junior developers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Python experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Experience with databases such as MongoDB.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies, such as HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design.
  • Understanding of security best practices in web development.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with JavaScript development tools such as Storybook and Playwright.
  • Experience with API integrations with platforms like Workday or similar.

title: AI Video Ad Creator +  Copywriter + Visual Asset Designer
description:
The opportunity


We’re building a high-output creative engine for paid ads-and we’re looking for a specialist who can write the words that sell and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form video ads using AI video tools, strong editing, and performance thinking.


This is not a “make pretty videos” role. This is concept → copy → creative → iterations → winners .

If you live at the intersection of genAI + storytelling + conversion copywriting , this role is for you.


You’ll create AI-driven video ads and visual assets for campaigns across TikTok, Instagram Reels/Stories, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and more. We optimize for ROAS, CTR, CVR, hook rate, hold rate, and retention -and the copywriting is a core lever in every asset we ship.


What you’ll do


You own the creative from message to motion-including the copywriting .

Copywriting + creative strategy

  • Write conversion-focused short-form scripts (15-45s) : hooks, problem framing, proof, offer, CTA.
  • Create multiple copy angles per concept (pain-based, benefit-based, curiosity, contrarian, founder POV, social proof, demo-driven).
  • Write and version hook lines, VO scripts, on-screen text, captions, headlines, end-card CTAs , and thumbnail copy.
  • Translate product benefits into clear, punchy, platform-native messaging (no fluff, no generic AI-sounding copy).
  • Apply direct-response frameworks (Problem → Agitation → Solution, Before/After, Myth-busting, Objection handling, etc.) with modern pacing.

Video production + asset creation

  • Produce short-form ad creatives designed for conversion (tight cuts, retention-first pacing, pattern interrupts).
  • Create AI-generated video sequences and combine them with real footage/UGC where needed.
  • Generate visual assets for ad variations: thumbnails, product scenes, backgrounds, overlays, cutdowns, motion graphics, end cards.
  • Build multiple versions of the same concept (different hooks, copy angles, pacing, captions, VO, formats).
  • Work from a brief and deliver fast iterations based on performance feedback.
  • Maintain brand consistency while still pushing creative boundaries.
  • Collaborate with growth/marketing to align creative with testing strategy and learnings.


Minimum requirements (non-negotiable)


To be considered, you must meet the requirements below and include proof in your application:

  • Resume must be written in English.
  • You must share examples of your AI video ad work with VO and Dialogue (not just AI visuals).
  • Copywriting is required: you must provide evidence you wrote/owned the scripts and ad copy for at least some of the work you share (scripts, hook lists, on-screen text, captions, or a short case study describing your role).
  • You must provide at least ONE of the following:
  • Evidence you produced creatives that generated strong ROAS / conversion lift (screenshots, case study, or summary metrics), OR
  • A video you produced that achieved 10,000+ views , OR
  • Proof you can create complex AI short-form ad videos (not basic slideshow edits-think narrative, scene continuity, ad pacing, multiple AI shots, strong compositing).
  • You have managed or been part of a social media account with 10,000+ followers .


What “qualified” looks like (skills we’re actively looking for)


You don’t just edit-you communicate and convert.

  • You understand what makes a video ad perform: thumb-stopping hooks, clear messaging, pattern interrupts, pacing, proof, offer structure, CTA clarity .
  • You can write direct-response copy that sounds human, specific, and brand-right-not generic “AI marketing” language.
  • You can create AI-driven visuals that look intentional and brand-ready (not uncanny or generic).
  • You can edit like a performance creator: tight cuts, retention-first pacing, captions, kinetic typography, sound design.
  • You have a repeatable workflow to deliver high volume with high quality (and keep assets organized).


Tools & workflows (use what you’re best at)


We’re tool-agnostic, but you should be highly capable with several of the following:

AI + creative

  • AI video generation (e.g., Runway, Pika, or comparable tools)
  • AI image generation (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Voice & audio (AI voiceover tools, sound design, music selection, cleanup)

Editing + delivery

  • Editing & motion (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, etc.)
  • Creative versioning + organized file delivery (naming conventions, aspect ratios, exports)

Copywriting workflow (important)

  • You can work quickly in tools like Docs/Notion , and you know how to build:
  • Hook banks
  • Script variations
  • Angle matrices
  • Offer/CTA libraries
  • Caption + primary text variants aligned to the video


Deliverables & expectations


Typical output: 10 ad creatives per month (depending on campaign cycle), plus variations.

Format mastery: 9:16 primary , plus 1:1 and 16:9 cutdowns when needed.

You can deliver:

  • Final exports (platform-ready)
  • Project files when requested
  • Source assets used (AI outputs, overlays, audio references)

Copy deliverables (required):

  • Script + VO text (or structured script outline)
  • Hook variations (often 5-15 per concept)
  • On-screen text + caption plan (what appears when, and why)
  • End card copy + CTA variants
  • Optional: primary text/caption variants for Meta/TikTok where needed

Turnaround: fast iteration is key (often 24-72 hours per revision cycle , depending on scope).


How we evaluate success


  • Your creatives clearly map to an angle + message and drive action.
  • Iterations improve performance (hooks improve, retention improves, CTR/CVR improves).
  • Your output is consistent, organized, and easy to test at scale.
  • Your copy + editing work together (the words and visuals reinforce the same conversion story).

﻿

Compensation


Competitive and flexible based on experience and proof of performance.

Per project bases

If you’re a performance-minded AI creative who can write high-converting scripts and ship high-quality ads fast -and you have proof-apply with the items above.

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

O Analista Contábil Pleno será responsável pela execução e suporte das rotinas contábeis em um ambiente de terceirização de processos (BPO), garantindo a precisão nas operações contábeis e aderência às normas e legislações vigentes. Atuará diretamente com diversos sistemas ERP, sendo responsável pela conciliação contábil, fechamentos mensais e apuração de resultados, além de prestar suporte em projetos de migração de sistemas e melhorias de processos. Esta oportunidade é voltada para Concessionárias de Veículos.


Fazendo parte do time você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Fazer parte de uma equipe vencedora e trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo;
  • Aprender e crescer profissionalmente com treinamentos e workshops;
  • Ter um impacto real na empresa, ajudando-a a alcançar seus objetivos;
  • Desfrutar de uma excelente remuneração e benefícios incríveis,
  • Conciliar sua vida pessoal e profissional com uma jornada de trabalho compatível, pois presamos pelo bem estar de nossos colaboradores.


DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:


Qualificações Necessárias:

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis (CRC ativo ou em andamento).
  • Conhecimento atualizado em normas contábeis (BRGAAP, IFRS).
  • Domínio em lançamentos contábeis, conciliações, fechamento de balanços e balancetes.
  • Experiência no uso de diferentes sistemas ERP para a execução de rotinas contábeis.
  • Conhecimento em obrigações acessórias relacionadas à contabilidade, como SPED Contábil e ECF.


Experiência Desejável:

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência na área contábil, preferencialmente em empresas de BPO ou consultorias.
  • Atuação com diversos sistemas de ERP (ex: TOTVS, SAP, Omie, Sankhya, Linx, Questor), garantindo adaptação a diferentes plataformas tecnológicas.
  • Vivência em processos de conciliação bancária, provisões, e controle de ativo imobilizado.
  • Experiência em projetos de migração de sistemas contábeis e integração de dados entre sistemas.


Obs: Conhecimento no sistema Linx, será um grande diferencial.

Autonomia:

  • Possuem maior autonomia para realizar suas tarefas e tomar decisões.
  • Podem supervisionar e orientar analistas Junior.


Principais atividades:

  • Conciliação contábil e bancária, assegurando que os lançamentos sejam devidamente registrados e conferidos em sistemas ERP diversos.
  • Fechamento contábil mensal e anual, garantindo a preparação e revisão de balanços, balancetes e demonstrações financeiras.
  • Análise de resultados e elaboração de relatórios contábeis, garantindo a correta apuração dos dados e aderência às normas contábeis.
  • Geração e entrega das obrigações acessórias contábeis, como SPED Contábil e ECF, em conformidade com os prazos e exigências legais.
  • Participação em projetos de migração e integração de sistemas ERP, realizando ajustes contábeis e adequando as rotinas de acordo com os novos sistemas implantados.
  • Suporte ao atendimento de auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo as informações contábeis necessárias para revisão e avaliação.
  • Gerenciar a equipe contábil, promovendo o desenvolvimento contínuo dos colaboradores, é responsável pela aplicação da Avaliação de Desempenho da equipe, elaboração de PDIs, controle de jornada de ponto, e reuniões de feedbacks com a equipe.


OFERECEMOS

  • ·       Salário compatível
  • ·       Vale alimentação/Refeição: para contribuir com sua alimentação;
  • ·        Auxílio Educação: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento profissional com um auxílio de até R$ 300,00 mensais (conforme política da empresa);
  • ·        Pesquisa de Clima: Pesquisa de clima e sugestões para garantir o bem-estar de nossos profissionais.
  • ·       PDI: Planeje seu desenvolvimento profissional e alcance seus objetivos de carreira com a ajuda da empresa;
  • ·       Premiação anual: Reconhecendo seu esforço e desempenho com premiação com base nos resultados da empresa (conforme política interna).


Então não perca tempo e envie seu currículo, agora mesmo!

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles



Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Program Coordinator
description:
About Sofia Health

Sofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1:1 services, we’re making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses.


Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, iRest, health coaching, and more.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Virtual Wellness Program Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our Sofia Prime program. In this role, you’ll help with day-to-day operations, communicate with instructors, support clients, ensure a seamless experience for both sides of the platform, and help expand participation and engagement across the platform.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role ideal for someone passionate about wellness, tech-enabled solutions, and community building.


Responsibilities
  • Coordinate and publish weekly and monthly live class schedules
  • Communicate with wellness instructors to confirm availability, gather class details, and ensure timely updates
  • Provide basic support to clients and instructors (e.g., tech check-ins, live session support, FAQs)
  • Assist with monitoring class attendance and flagging any issues or trends
  • Help gather and organize feedback from members to improve class offerings
  • Collaborate with marketing and community teams to promote upcoming classes
  • Maintain accurate records and help ensure consistent program delivery


Requirements
  • 1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
  • Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Bonus Points
  • Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup
  • Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company
  • Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

title: Arquiteto de integração
description:

  • Responsável pela análise, design e manutenção do desenho de solução de integração para múltiplos projetos e sistemas. Irá avaliar a solução AS-IS e desenhar a solução ToBe, elaborar o documento de arquitetura técnica de Integração com a solução end to end das funcionalidades, definindo o datamapping e swagger das APIs, levando em consideração o TMFórum, OpenAPI e 4P, conforme definido na arquitetura de referência.

  • Responsável por desenhar, especificar e implementar API's e Microserviços (novas e alterações) para projetos de transformação digital.
  • Desenvolver Backends com Spring / SpringBoot /Node Js
  • Auxiliar na avaliação e implementação de novas iniciativas tecnológicas e DevOps
  • Acompanhar, orientar e validar o desenvolvimento da equipe que será composta por outros desenvolvedores Junior, Pleno e Senior.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento utilizando conceitos/arquitetura em Microserviços.
  • Experiência em Padrões de segurança para arquitetura de microserviços como Token JWT, protocolo OAUTH e implementação de SSL2Way
  • Domínio no Desenvolvimento de API REST
  • Conhecimentos em arquitetura orientada a serviços (SOA).
  • Experiência em soluções utilizando Arquitetura distribuída, Microserviços e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos
  • Conhecimento em Automatização de testes;
  • Conhecimento em Linguagem Java e seus principais frameworks: Spring, SpringBoot, Maven, JUnit
  • Conhecimento em Soluções de consumo e publicação de mensagens em broker de eventos Kafka
  • Conhecimento em Conceitos de banco de dados relacional e não relacional
  • Conhecimento em Padrões e conceitos de exposição de API´s através do API Gateway
  • Experiência em Oracle SOA Suite 11g/12c (OSB, BPEL, BAM, Rules).
  • Experiência em Oracle Service Bus 11g/12c.
  • Experiência com Web Services (RESTful e SOAP).
  • Experiência em Enterprise Manager, DVN, XML, WSDL, WADL, XSD, JSON. xQuery, xPath, JAVA e PL/SQL.
  • Modelagem de entidades canônicas (SID);
  • Conhecimento de TMForum;
  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes com grande demanda por integrações.
  • Experiência com JIRA, Quality Center, Jenkins, SVN e GIT.
  • Softskill: criativo, gosta de resolver problemas, proativo, engenhoso.



Desejável Conhecimento em:

  • Plataforma de Container (Kubernetes)
  • Conhecimento de pipelines CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em DataPower.
  • Experiência em Telecom.

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: AI Video Ad Creator +  Copywriter + Visual Asset Designer
description:
The opportunity


We’re building a high-output creative engine for paid ads-and we’re looking for a specialist who can write the words that sell and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form video ads using AI video tools, strong editing, and performance thinking.


This is not a “make pretty videos” role. This is concept → copy → creative → iterations → winners .

If you live at the intersection of genAI + storytelling + conversion copywriting , this role is for you.


You’ll create AI-driven video ads and visual assets for campaigns across TikTok, Instagram Reels/Stories, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and more. We optimize for ROAS, CTR, CVR, hook rate, hold rate, and retention -and the copywriting is a core lever in every asset we ship.


What you’ll do


You own the creative from message to motion-including the copywriting .

Copywriting + creative strategy

  • Write conversion-focused short-form scripts (15-45s) : hooks, problem framing, proof, offer, CTA.
  • Create multiple copy angles per concept (pain-based, benefit-based, curiosity, contrarian, founder POV, social proof, demo-driven).
  • Write and version hook lines, VO scripts, on-screen text, captions, headlines, end-card CTAs , and thumbnail copy.
  • Translate product benefits into clear, punchy, platform-native messaging (no fluff, no generic AI-sounding copy).
  • Apply direct-response frameworks (Problem → Agitation → Solution, Before/After, Myth-busting, Objection handling, etc.) with modern pacing.

Video production + asset creation

  • Produce short-form ad creatives designed for conversion (tight cuts, retention-first pacing, pattern interrupts).
  • Create AI-generated video sequences and combine them with real footage/UGC where needed.
  • Generate visual assets for ad variations: thumbnails, product scenes, backgrounds, overlays, cutdowns, motion graphics, end cards.
  • Build multiple versions of the same concept (different hooks, copy angles, pacing, captions, VO, formats).
  • Work from a brief and deliver fast iterations based on performance feedback.
  • Maintain brand consistency while still pushing creative boundaries.
  • Collaborate with growth/marketing to align creative with testing strategy and learnings.


Minimum requirements (non-negotiable)


To be considered, you must meet the requirements below and include proof in your application:

  • Resume must be written in English.
  • You must share examples of your AI video ad work with VO and Dialogue (not just AI visuals).
  • Copywriting is required: you must provide evidence you wrote/owned the scripts and ad copy for at least some of the work you share (scripts, hook lists, on-screen text, captions, or a short case study describing your role).
  • You must provide at least ONE of the following:
  • Evidence you produced creatives that generated strong ROAS / conversion lift (screenshots, case study, or summary metrics), OR
  • A video you produced that achieved 10,000+ views , OR
  • Proof you can create complex AI short-form ad videos (not basic slideshow edits-think narrative, scene continuity, ad pacing, multiple AI shots, strong compositing).
  • You have managed or been part of a social media account with 10,000+ followers .


What “qualified” looks like (skills we’re actively looking for)


You don’t just edit-you communicate and convert.

  • You understand what makes a video ad perform: thumb-stopping hooks, clear messaging, pattern interrupts, pacing, proof, offer structure, CTA clarity .
  • You can write direct-response copy that sounds human, specific, and brand-right-not generic “AI marketing” language.
  • You can create AI-driven visuals that look intentional and brand-ready (not uncanny or generic).
  • You can edit like a performance creator: tight cuts, retention-first pacing, captions, kinetic typography, sound design.
  • You have a repeatable workflow to deliver high volume with high quality (and keep assets organized).


Tools & workflows (use what you’re best at)


We’re tool-agnostic, but you should be highly capable with several of the following:

AI + creative

  • AI video generation (e.g., Runway, Pika, or comparable tools)
  • AI image generation (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Voice & audio (AI voiceover tools, sound design, music selection, cleanup)

Editing + delivery

  • Editing & motion (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, etc.)
  • Creative versioning + organized file delivery (naming conventions, aspect ratios, exports)

Copywriting workflow (important)

  • You can work quickly in tools like Docs/Notion , and you know how to build:
  • Hook banks
  • Script variations
  • Angle matrices
  • Offer/CTA libraries
  • Caption + primary text variants aligned to the video


Deliverables & expectations


Typical output: 10 ad creatives per month (depending on campaign cycle), plus variations.

Format mastery: 9:16 primary , plus 1:1 and 16:9 cutdowns when needed.

You can deliver:

  • Final exports (platform-ready)
  • Project files when requested
  • Source assets used (AI outputs, overlays, audio references)

Copy deliverables (required):

  • Script + VO text (or structured script outline)
  • Hook variations (often 5-15 per concept)
  • On-screen text + caption plan (what appears when, and why)
  • End card copy + CTA variants
  • Optional: primary text/caption variants for Meta/TikTok where needed

Turnaround: fast iteration is key (often 24-72 hours per revision cycle , depending on scope).


How we evaluate success


  • Your creatives clearly map to an angle + message and drive action.
  • Iterations improve performance (hooks improve, retention improves, CTR/CVR improves).
  • Your output is consistent, organized, and easy to test at scale.
  • Your copy + editing work together (the words and visuals reinforce the same conversion story).

﻿

Compensation


Competitive and flexible based on experience and proof of performance.

Per project bases

If you’re a performance-minded AI creative who can write high-converting scripts and ship high-quality ads fast -and you have proof-apply with the items above.

description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;

● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;

● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;

● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);

● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável)

● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos

● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência


Bancos de Dados e Persistência

● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos)

● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers

● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS

● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia

● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial)

Assistência Médica

title: Digital Marketing Project Manager
description:
B2B Digital Project Manager & Account Lead (Remote)The Opportunity

Digital Estate Media is looking for a high-performing, proactive Project Manager & Account Lead to join our team. We are a digital agency specializing in integrated growth strategies for B2B and Enterprise clients.

PLEASE SUBMIT ENGLISH RESUME'S ONLY.. THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE TO SUPPORT NORTH AMERICAN CLIENTS.

This is a full-time (30+ hours per week) remote position with a focus on candidates in South America or Europe . We need an \"Engine Room\" leader who takes extreme ownership of client success, has a meticulous eye for design, and can track complex data across multiple service lines without breaking a sweat.

Your Core Mission

To act as the primary bridge between our clients and our internal specialist teams, ensuring that SEO, Google Ads, Email Marketing, and LinkedIn Outreach move forward as one cohesive machine, while supporting the agency's daily operational and content workflows.

Responsibilities1. Expert Service Tracking & Orchestration

  • Project Management: Manage and organize all project details in Asana . Track deliverables and deadlines to ensure the specialist team stays on schedule.
  • Service Tracking: Maintain the \"Central Source of Truth\" for SEO (rankings), Ads (spend/conversions), Email (open rates), and LinkedIn (qualified leads).
  • Document Organization: Handle all file management across Google Drive and Dropbox to ensure a clean, accessible environment for the team.
  • Responsible for a growing portfolio of clients 5+ projects with multiple services

2. Account Management & High-Level Communication

  • Client Lead: Act as the primary point of contact. Lead weekly video calls (via Zoom) and monthly strategy sessions.
  • Onboarding: Assist with onboarding new clients and training internal team members on our systems.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Anticipate client needs and solve issues before they become bottlenecks.

3. Content & Technical Support

  • Digital Updates: Support the team by uploading social media content, blog posts, and website updates using WordPress and Meta Business Suite .
  • Aesthetic & Quality Governance: Review all ad creatives, email templates, and landing pages. If a graphic is off-brand or unprofessional, you are the one to catch it and send it back for revision.
  • Copywriting Review: Ensure all client-facing text and outreach scripts are in perfect, high-level English.

Requirements

  • The \"Go-Getter\" Attitude: You don't just \"check boxes.\" You are resourceful, proactive, and treat the client’s business as if it were your own.
  • Strong Communication: Flawless written and verbal English. You can confidently communicate with CEOs and Marketing Directors in a professional, sophisticated tone.
  • Technical Familiarity: Mastery of Asana , Slack, and Google Workspace. Basic familiarity with Meta Business Suite, WordPress, and Canva .
  • Design Sensibility: A keen eye for modern UI/UX, typography, and brand consistency.
  • Availability: Must be responsive during normal business hours (EST ) and available for weekly Zoom meetings.
  • B2B Context: Understanding of long sales cycles (6-12 months) and digital marketing terminology (SEO, CPC, CTR, etc.).

Compensation & Performance Upside

We believe in rewarding those who drive growth. This role offers a professional base salary plus a performance-based bonus tied directly to the scale of the active accounts you manage.

  • Base Compensation: $1,500 - $2,000 CAD per month.
  • Portfolio Bonus: $300 CAD bonus for every $10,000 in active monthly project revenue you manage.
  • Example: A PM managing a portfolio of projects worth $40,000 in monthly revenue would earn $2,000 (Base) + $1,200 (Bonus) = $3,200 CAD per month.
  • Growth: Opportunities to expand responsibilities and base pay as the agency scales.

How to Apply

Please include:

  • A short introduction about you and your experience working with marketing agencies or creative teams.
  • Examples of similar project coordination, account management, or design-review work.
  • A brief video introduction (Loom preferred). In your video, tell us about a time you took ownership of a project that was failing and turned it around.

We are looking for a long-term partner, not a freelancer. If you are a proactive leader with a passion for digital strategy and design, we want to talk to you.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Digital Marketing Project Manager
description:
B2B Digital Project Manager & Account Lead (Remote)The Opportunity

Digital Estate Media is looking for a high-performing, proactive Project Manager & Account Lead to join our team. We are a digital agency specializing in integrated growth strategies for B2B and Enterprise clients.

PLEASE SUBMIT ENGLISH RESUME'S ONLY.. THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE TO SUPPORT NORTH AMERICAN CLIENTS.

This is a full-time (30+ hours per week) remote position with a focus on candidates in South America or Europe . We need an \"Engine Room\" leader who takes extreme ownership of client success, has a meticulous eye for design, and can track complex data across multiple service lines without breaking a sweat.

Your Core Mission

To act as the primary bridge between our clients and our internal specialist teams, ensuring that SEO, Google Ads, Email Marketing, and LinkedIn Outreach move forward as one cohesive machine, while supporting the agency's daily operational and content workflows.

Responsibilities1. Expert Service Tracking & Orchestration

  • Project Management: Manage and organize all project details in Asana . Track deliverables and deadlines to ensure the specialist team stays on schedule.
  • Service Tracking: Maintain the \"Central Source of Truth\" for SEO (rankings), Ads (spend/conversions), Email (open rates), and LinkedIn (qualified leads).
  • Document Organization: Handle all file management across Google Drive and Dropbox to ensure a clean, accessible environment for the team.
  • Responsible for a growing portfolio of clients 5+ projects with multiple services

2. Account Management & High-Level Communication

  • Client Lead: Act as the primary point of contact. Lead weekly video calls (via Zoom) and monthly strategy sessions.
  • Onboarding: Assist with onboarding new clients and training internal team members on our systems.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Anticipate client needs and solve issues before they become bottlenecks.

3. Content & Technical Support

  • Digital Updates: Support the team by uploading social media content, blog posts, and website updates using WordPress and Meta Business Suite .
  • Aesthetic & Quality Governance: Review all ad creatives, email templates, and landing pages. If a graphic is off-brand or unprofessional, you are the one to catch it and send it back for revision.
  • Copywriting Review: Ensure all client-facing text and outreach scripts are in perfect, high-level English.

Requirements

  • The \"Go-Getter\" Attitude: You don't just \"check boxes.\" You are resourceful, proactive, and treat the client’s business as if it were your own.
  • Strong Communication: Flawless written and verbal English. You can confidently communicate with CEOs and Marketing Directors in a professional, sophisticated tone.
  • Technical Familiarity: Mastery of Asana , Slack, and Google Workspace. Basic familiarity with Meta Business Suite, WordPress, and Canva .
  • Design Sensibility: A keen eye for modern UI/UX, typography, and brand consistency.
  • Availability: Must be responsive during normal business hours (EST ) and available for weekly Zoom meetings.
  • B2B Context: Understanding of long sales cycles (6-12 months) and digital marketing terminology (SEO, CPC, CTR, etc.).

Compensation & Performance Upside

We believe in rewarding those who drive growth. This role offers a professional base salary plus a performance-based bonus tied directly to the scale of the active accounts you manage.

  • Base Compensation: $1,500 - $2,000 CAD per month.
  • Portfolio Bonus: $300 CAD bonus for every $10,000 in active monthly project revenue you manage.
  • Example: A PM managing a portfolio of projects worth $40,000 in monthly revenue would earn $2,000 (Base) + $1,200 (Bonus) = $3,200 CAD per month.
  • Growth: Opportunities to expand responsibilities and base pay as the agency scales.

How to Apply

Please include:

  • A short introduction about you and your experience working with marketing agencies or creative teams.
  • Examples of similar project coordination, account management, or design-review work.
  • A brief video introduction (Loom preferred). In your video, tell us about a time you took ownership of a project that was failing and turned it around.

We are looking for a long-term partner, not a freelancer. If you are a proactive leader with a passion for digital strategy and design, we want to talk to you.

description:
We are hiring for our North America Client

Payment is USD ; Monthly Pay ; No Benefits

Candidate need to have an excellent English communication skills

Candidate need to use their own laptop for work

Resume need to be shared in English format



7 months contract ; May extend

Remote role


Position Purpose:

Client is currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.


Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference, conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking

experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield

S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business

processes.


This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and adoption.


The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process

owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data

requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.


Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

• Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned to standardized value stream processes.

• Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for S/4HANA.

• Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies.

• Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make,Deliver, Return)


Functional Process Data Ownership

Responsibilities include:

• Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

• Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

• Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.


Data Migration & Readiness

• Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

• Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

• Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.

• Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.


Data Governance & Standards

• Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

• Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

• Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

• Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.


Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

• Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.

• Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

• Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

• Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.


Required Qualifications

Experience

• 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

• Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

• Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

• Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.


Technical & Functional Skills

• Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business

Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

• Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.

• Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.

• Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).

• Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.


Soft Skills

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.

• Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.

• Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.

• Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.

• Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!

title: Digital Marketing Project Manager
description:
B2B Digital Project Manager & Account Lead (Remote)The Opportunity

Digital Estate Media is looking for a high-performing, proactive Project Manager & Account Lead to join our team. We are a digital agency specializing in integrated growth strategies for B2B and Enterprise clients.

PLEASE SUBMIT ENGLISH RESUME'S ONLY.. THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE TO SUPPORT NORTH AMERICAN CLIENTS.

This is a full-time (30+ hours per week) remote position with a focus on candidates in South America or Europe . We need an \"Engine Room\" leader who takes extreme ownership of client success, has a meticulous eye for design, and can track complex data across multiple service lines without breaking a sweat.

Your Core Mission

To act as the primary bridge between our clients and our internal specialist teams, ensuring that SEO, Google Ads, Email Marketing, and LinkedIn Outreach move forward as one cohesive machine, while supporting the agency's daily operational and content workflows.

Responsibilities1. Expert Service Tracking & Orchestration

  • Project Management: Manage and organize all project details in Asana . Track deliverables and deadlines to ensure the specialist team stays on schedule.
  • Service Tracking: Maintain the \"Central Source of Truth\" for SEO (rankings), Ads (spend/conversions), Email (open rates), and LinkedIn (qualified leads).
  • Document Organization: Handle all file management across Google Drive and Dropbox to ensure a clean, accessible environment for the team.
  • Responsible for a growing portfolio of clients 5+ projects with multiple services

2. Account Management & High-Level Communication

  • Client Lead: Act as the primary point of contact. Lead weekly video calls (via Zoom) and monthly strategy sessions.
  • Onboarding: Assist with onboarding new clients and training internal team members on our systems.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Anticipate client needs and solve issues before they become bottlenecks.

3. Content & Technical Support

  • Digital Updates: Support the team by uploading social media content, blog posts, and website updates using WordPress and Meta Business Suite .
  • Aesthetic & Quality Governance: Review all ad creatives, email templates, and landing pages. If a graphic is off-brand or unprofessional, you are the one to catch it and send it back for revision.
  • Copywriting Review: Ensure all client-facing text and outreach scripts are in perfect, high-level English.

Requirements

  • The \"Go-Getter\" Attitude: You don't just \"check boxes.\" You are resourceful, proactive, and treat the client’s business as if it were your own.
  • Strong Communication: Flawless written and verbal English. You can confidently communicate with CEOs and Marketing Directors in a professional, sophisticated tone.
  • Technical Familiarity: Mastery of Asana , Slack, and Google Workspace. Basic familiarity with Meta Business Suite, WordPress, and Canva .
  • Design Sensibility: A keen eye for modern UI/UX, typography, and brand consistency.
  • Availability: Must be responsive during normal business hours (EST ) and available for weekly Zoom meetings.
  • B2B Context: Understanding of long sales cycles (6-12 months) and digital marketing terminology (SEO, CPC, CTR, etc.).

Compensation & Performance Upside

We believe in rewarding those who drive growth. This role offers a professional base salary plus a performance-based bonus tied directly to the scale of the active accounts you manage.

  • Base Compensation: $1,500 - $2,000 CAD per month.
  • Portfolio Bonus: $300 CAD bonus for every $10,000 in active monthly project revenue you manage.
  • Example: A PM managing a portfolio of projects worth $40,000 in monthly revenue would earn $2,000 (Base) + $1,200 (Bonus) = $3,200 CAD per month.
  • Growth: Opportunities to expand responsibilities and base pay as the agency scales.

How to Apply

Please include:

  • A short introduction about you and your experience working with marketing agencies or creative teams.
  • Examples of similar project coordination, account management, or design-review work.
  • A brief video introduction (Loom preferred). In your video, tell us about a time you took ownership of a project that was failing and turned it around.

We are looking for a long-term partner, not a freelancer. If you are a proactive leader with a passion for digital strategy and design, we want to talk to you.

title: SAP S/4HANA Functional Data Consultant/Lead
description:
We are hiring for our North America Client

Payment is USD ; Monthly Pay ; No Benefits

Candidate need to have 2 week notice period

Candidate need to have an excellent English communication skills

Candidate need to use their own laptop for work

Resume need to be shared in English format



7 months contract ; May extend

Remote role


Position Purpose:

Client is currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.


Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference, conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking

experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield

S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business

processes.


This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and adoption.


The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process

owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data

requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.


Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

• Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned to standardized value stream processes.

• Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for S/4HANA.

• Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies.

• Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make,Deliver, Return)


Functional Process Data Ownership

Responsibilities include:

• Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

• Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

• Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.


Data Migration & Readiness

• Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

• Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

• Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.

• Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.


Data Governance & Standards

• Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

• Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

• Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

• Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.


Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

• Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.

• Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

• Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

• Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.


Required Qualifications

Experience

• 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

• Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

• Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

• Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.


Technical & Functional Skills

• Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business

Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

• Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.

• Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.

• Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).

• Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.


Soft Skills

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.

• Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.

• Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.

• Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.

• Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.

Você será a peça-chave para:

  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.

Principais Responsabilidades:

️Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.

Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.

Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.

Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.

Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.

O que Buscamos em Você:

  • Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.
  • Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha.
  • Mentalidade de Dono(a): Autonomia para planejar, agilidade para executar e flexibilidade para ajustar a rota em busca dos melhores resultados.

Nossa Proposta de Valor:

description:
Supervisor de Manutenção Mecânica – Planta de Beneficiamento

Local: Interior da Bahia, Brasil

Modelo de trabalho: Disponibilidade de mudança para a região (empresa oferece moradia)

Sobre a Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Supervisor de Manutenção Mecânica que será responsável por planejar, coordenar e acompanhar as atividades de manutenção mecânica em equipamentos industriais da usina, garantindo sua disponibilidade, confiabilidade e segurança operacional, de acordo com os padrões de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar e distribuir as atividades de manutenção mecânica preventiva, corretiva e preditiva em equipamentos da planta (britadores, moinhos, correias, tanques, bombas etc.);
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos planos de manutenção e paradas programadas, garantindo a execução dentro dos prazos, custos e padrões de segurança estabelecidos;
  • Acompanhar a execução de serviços internos e de terceiros, garantindo qualidade e conformidade com normas técnicas e de segurança;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de projetos de melhoria contínua, visando aumento da confiabilidade, redução de falhas e otimização de recursos;
  • Coordenar e orientar tecnicamente a equipe de manutenção, promovendo capacitação, integração e cultura de segurança;
  • Realizar e validar registros no sistema de gestão de manutenção, contribuindo para o controle de indicadores e relatórios gerenciais;
  • Apoiar o planejamento orçamentário e o controle de custos da manutenção mecânica;
  • Garantir o cumprimento rigoroso das normas de Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Compliance, assegurando a integridade das pessoas e dos equipamentos.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino Técnico Completo em Mecânica e/ou Eletromecânica;
  • Experiência em manutenção mecânica em equipamentos de usina de beneficiamento mineral (britadores, correias, bombas, peneiras, etc);
  • Vivência com gestão de equipes operacionais e contratos terceirizados;
  • Disponibilidade de mudança para o interior da Bahia.

title: Senior Manager, Regional Key Account Management
description:
This position will be accountable for managing, directing and leading the CEVA Logistics programs for BYD across the LATAM region.

Key Accountabilities

1

Ability to understand unique customer supply chain requirements and drive a particular sector focus

2

Identify business opportunities that add value to BYD logistics programs whilst generating business leads that meet and exceed business goals

3

Expansion/Growth is mission critical to the role. Senior relationship management and service execution are two key components to insure account expansion/growth is achieved

4

Retention is key to grow portfolio of business across all product/service types within CEVA

5

Drive collaborative efforts between country and multiple product leaders within CEVA to meet the needs of customers

6

Prospecting for all products opportunities and delivering compelling solutions, value and pricing

7

Maintain an Account Plan for the customer that will encompass a strategic roadmap defining multi-year growth, targets by key supply chain

8

Execute Account Plans (forecasts, budgets and operating plans)

9

Ability to work in a matrix organization along with virtual teams & build strong internal relationships with Sponsor/Global/Regional/Sector team leaders as required for the account

10

Build strategic relationships with key contacts within customer organizations to understand opportunities for creating value

11

Stay aligned and team work with GKAM and other region RKAMs

12

Conduct regular business review meetings with customers and drive meeting content to ensure operations, support and execution teams are present to support these reviews

13

Responsible to communicate all expectations on these review meetings to the operations and support teams for implementation or improvements

14

Lead & create innovation solution with team based on deep understanding of business streams of customer

15

Leverage on Sectors Focused Solutions to penetrate account growth and development (Eg. Use of case studies and key SMART solutions within CEVA)

16

Work with implementation teams on new projects to ensure customer expectations are communicated

17

Lead and work with customer to resolve all contractual and commercial decisions in compliance with CEVA policies and terms

18

Continue cross selling within CEVA and CMA CGM group to maximize biz portfolio for the group

19

Accurate and timely update of all customer engagement activities and business development opportunities within C-View

20

Need to support other China-Brazil sales leads and Chinese projects/business

Requirements

  • Minimum 10 years industry experience.
  • Minimum 8 years account management managerial and/or customer relationship management experience required.
  • Bachelor degree holder majoring in supply chain/logistics/ /transportation management/sales and marketing/international business
  • In-depth knowledge of all air,sea, ground and contract logistics products and services.
  • Excellent planning, time management, collaboration, decision making, organization, presentation and negotiating skills.
  • Strong background in sales and marketing and a proven track recordin business development and growth.
  • Demonstrated success in managing (KPI's) Key Performance Indicators.
  • Demonstrated success in problem solving through use of data and information metrics and improvement to performance process.
  • Proficient in project management methodologies with a focus on managing solution driven strategy plans to achieve goals.
  • Experienced in financial management (P&L's, Balance Sheets,forecasting and budgets) to effectuate return on investment.
  • Manages complex or emotional customer situations promptly andprofessionally meeting commitments for service and assistance.
  • Maintains stable performance underpressure or opposition; handling stress in a mannerthat is acceptable to others and the organization.
  • Uses appropriate methods and a flexible interpersonal style to help build a cohesive teamand facilitates the completion of team goals.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Fluent in both Chinese and English
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook);

title: Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You're looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement.
  • Deep expertise in AWS, especially working with services like ECS, IAM, and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, ideally using frameworks like Backstage.
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic, such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced).

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform, enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS, based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows, including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.
